description: Define a local runner adapter contract for moving beyond inline fixture analysis without cloud spend.
Add a command to append structured cycle notes to the research loop journal.
Warn when stratified fixture cells are sparse, especially for effect-modification questions.
Add a machine-readable packet summary command that combines stages, checkpoint, manifest, export record, and report review into one orchestration document.
Introduce a registry abstraction that supports medical datasets beyond NHANES without tying the pipeline shape to one substrate.
Add deterministic validators for study design, estimand clarity, missingness, survey/statistical method selection, and data-quality risks.
